lines: This was supposed to be for the first aid kit. Then the kids found it.
One little scrape and it's tears, a bandaid fight, and a bandaid that peels off five minutes later.
This is Boo-Boo Gel. One pump is a pearl-size dot, and they dab it on themselves. No sting.
It feels cool, dries clear and isn't greasy. Four ingredients, vegan, made in the USA.
Only downside? Now they want it on every tiny bump, even the ones I can't see.
It's small enough for a backpack, so grab one for school and one for the car before the next scrape. It's in the orange cart.
